verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a built-in Vanta AI Agent that works across the platform to draft policies, complete questionnaires and flag issues. The pricing page lists it with agentic search and asking questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents. Domain agents add more delegable tasks: the TPRM Agent, agentic questionnaire workflows, and Vanta AI reviewing evidence and suggesting fixes. The external MCP server is not credited here, since it is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how tasks are delegated to the in-app agent and its limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
